description:
Because:

* FxA moves shared code from fxa-shared to Nx libs under libs/shared.
* fxa-auth-server must load only one copy of the Amplitude code.
* initialize typed group as a GROUPS key, but callers pass a GROUPS value.

This commit:

* Adds libs/shared/metrics/amplitude with the moved module and schema.
* Ports the mocha spec to jest and deletes the mocha file.
* Moves the auth-server callers and makes fxa-shared a re-export shim.
* Adds ajv to the root package.json and the tsconfig.base.json path.
* Types group as a GROUPS value (GROUPS as const) and drops the spec cast.

Closes FXA-14710
